title: Low stock alert from your inventory sheet
summary: Every morning, find items at or below their reorder level in your inventory sheet and text the owner the list.
description: Every day at the time you choose, reads your inventory sheet (columns: item, quantity, reorder_level), picks the items at or below their reorder level, and, if there are any, texts the owner the list so stock can be reordered in time. The owner's phone number is the tenant variable owner_phone.

variables.name: owner_phone
variables.why: The owner's phone number in international format without +.

params.name: spreadsheet_id
params.title: Inventory spreadsheet
params.description: The spreadsheet's id, from its link.

params.name: send_time
params.title: Time
params.description: When the check runs, Lagos time.

params.name: sms_connection
params.title: Termii connection
params.description: The name of your Termii connection.

params.name: sheets_connection
params.title: Google Sheets connection
params.description: The name of your Google Sheets connection.

steps.name: Pick the items at or below their reorder level

output.items: =(has(steps.read_stock.output.objects) ? steps.read_stock.output.objects : []).filter(r, has(r.item) && r.item != null && has(r.quantity) && r.quantity != null && has(r.reorder_level) && r.reorder_level != null && double(r.quantity) <= double(r.reorder_level)).map(r, string(r.item))

steps.name: Text the owner what to reorder
